AnyLaser.Description: Two new parts for the data port and microcontroller: the Laser Block shoots a beam up to 100 m and outputs hit and distance (input off switches it off), and the Laser Sensor outputs lit, broken and distance when a beam lands on its lens. Players block the beam. Sensor container in Sandbox and Creative, tier 3 loot in Survival. Single player and host; every player needs the mod. Anymaker 0.2.0 only.
